criteria.requirement: A linked flat dieline and 3D rectangular tuck-lid carton represent the same width/depth/height in millimeters.
criteria.action: Compare the initial flat dieline and carton with their dimensions.
criteria.expected: Both views represent the same rectangular tuck-lid carton in millimeters.

criteria.requirement: Changing dimensions updates both views, with clearly distinct cut and fold markings.
criteria.action: Change width, depth and height and compare both views.
criteria.expected: Both geometries update and cut edges remain distinguishable from fold lines.

criteria.requirement: The fold slider rotates connected panels about actual shared edges from flat to closed, with inspectable intermediate states.
criteria.action: Move the fold slider through flat, intermediate and closed positions; inspect different angles.
criteria.expected: Connected panels rotate about their shared edges and remain coherent throughout folding.

criteria.requirement: Front/back/sides/lid can receive independent shop-name artwork and colors; panel selection is linked across both views.
criteria.action: Select panels from each view and edit front, back, sides and lid artwork/colors independently.
criteria.expected: Selection is linked and changes affect the intended counterpart panel without overwriting unrelated panels.

criteria.requirement: Artwork stays attached and properly oriented while folding, with working sample and reset actions.
criteria.action: Fold an edited carton, then reset to the sample.
criteria.expected: Artwork stays attached and correctly oriented; reset restores the sample design.

criteria.requirement: Downloaded dimensioned SVG includes artwork and separate cut/fold marks; the prototype discloses zero thickness and excluded manufacturing tolerances/bleed.
criteria.action: Download and inspect the dimensioned SVG and proof notes.
criteria.expected: SVG includes artwork and separate cut/fold markings; zero thickness and excluded tolerances/bleed are disclosed.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect matching dimensions, flat net, closed carton and proof assumptions.
Change dimensions, select a panel from each view, change its artwork/color and inspect several fold positions.
Fold fully flat then closed, reset/load sample and inspect the downloaded SVG dimensions, artwork and cut/fold distinctions.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
